TAX LOT NO. 30 IN BLOCK NO. 42
DIMENSION OF LOT APPROXIMATELY: 25 FEET X 100 FEET
NEAREST CROSS STREET: BROADWAY (AKA 9TH STREET)
ALL THAT CERTAIN LOT, PIECE OR PARCEL OF LAND, WITH THE BUILDINGS AND IMPROVEMENTS THEREON ERECTED, SITUATE, LYING AND BEING IN THE TOWN OF WEST NEW YORK, COUNTY OF HUDSON, STATE OF NEW JERSEY.
BEGINNING AT A POINT ON THE NORTHEASTERLY SIDELINE OF 61ST STREET (A/K/A NILES AVENUE), SAID POINT BEING DISTANT 25.00 FEET NORTHWESTERLY FROM THE INTERSECTION OF THE SAID NORTHEASTERLY SIDELINE OF 61ST STREET WITH THE NORTHWESTERLY SIDELINE OF BROADWAY (A/K/A 9TH STREET) AND RUNNING; THENCE
1. NORTH 36 DEGREES 30 MINUTES 00 SECONDS EAST, TO, THROUGH AND BEYOND A PARTY WALL, 100.00 FEET TO APPOINT; THENCE
2. NORTH 53 DEGREES 30 MINUTES 00 SECONDS WEST, 25.00 FEET TO A POINT; THENCE
3. SOUTH 36 DEGREES 30 MINUTES 00 SECONDS WEST, TO, THROUGH AND BEYOND A PARTY WALL, 100.00 FEET TO A POINT IN THE NORTHEASTERLY SIDELINE OF 61ST STREET; THENCE
4. ALONG SAID NORTHEASTERLY SIDELINE OF 61ST STREET, SOUTH 53 DEGREES 30 MINUTES 00 SECONDS EAST, 25.00 FEET TO A POINT AND PLACE OF BEGINNING
